oneLineDescription: SaltHouse offers women's clothing, including knitwear, denim, and simple staples, with limited drops and a focus on quality craftsmanship.
targetAudience: Women aged 28-45 in coastal cities like Boston, Portland ME, Portsmouth, and Mystic, with household incomes of $80k-$180k, who own investment pieces and read publications like The Cut and House Beautiful.
uniqueSellingPoints: Knitwear is made by a small mill in Northern Ireland
Denim is selvedge, made in Japan
Founder is Eliza Brand — former buyer at Toast (the brand)
We do not run sales. Ever. Price is the price.
